contact.name: Eric Johnson
contact.evidence_quote: Hydrotemp, LLC was founded in May of 1993 by CEO Jerry Johnson. Jerry had acquired almost two decades of experience in the water heating and water treatment fields on a broad range of equipment. As President of Hydrotemp, Jerry's son Eric carries on his father's objective: applying our knowledge and expertise to providing superior service and up-to-date water heating industry information to our valued customers.
